Title: Fix: daily routine streak pays 5 bonuses instead of 1 at rollover
Body:
## Problem

A tablet Trackee with a single daily recurring task received **5** "daily routine streak" bonuses (10 pts each) at day rollover instead of 1. Production logs showed `DailyStreakService` posting one bonus per minute for 7:00–7:04 AM.

## Root cause

The day-rollover timer fires every minute and runs the rollover whenever the household-local time is within the **first 5 minutes after midnight** ([tasks.module.ts](apps/api/src/tasks/tasks.module.ts#L140-L149) — a window, so a minute-0 tick delayed by an event-loop stall or clock skew still rolls the day over). So `rolloverDay` runs **up to 5 times for the same calendar day**.

The pure engine's [`applyDay`](apps/api/src/tasks/daily-streak-engine.ts) had no idempotency guard on the `advance` path: each of the 5 runs re-classified the completed day as a qualifying advance and posted another `earn` — 5 bonuses (50 pts) for one day.

## Fix

Guard the advance path on `lastQualifyingDay` (already set to the day on the first successful advance):

```ts
if (prior.lastQualifyingDay === context.day) {
  return { state: prior };
}
```

Placed in the pure engine — cheapest, most testable layer, no migration. `break`/`non-event` were already idempotent.

## Tests

- **Unit** ([daily-streak-engine.spec.ts](apps/api/src/tasks/daily-streak-engine.spec.ts)) — re-running `advance` for an already-processed day is a no-op (no bonus, state preserved).
- **E2e** ([daily-streak-rollover.spec.ts](apps/e2e/src/tests/daily-streak-rollover.spec.ts)) — completes a task, ticks the streak scheduler 5×, asserts **exactly one** `daily routine streak` earn. Asserting *exactly* one pins both directions: a missing guard over-pays (5), an over-eager guard pays nothing.

Verified the e2e test fails without the guard (5 bonuses) and passes with it.

## Docs

[docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md) gains a **"Testing scheduler idempotency"** section: any function wired to a `setInterval` window must be safe to call N times for the same input — with both the pure-engine and e2e patterns. This is the proactive rule that would have caught the bug class.

## Verification

- `daily-streak-engine.spec.ts` — 15/15 pass
- `daily-streak-rollover.spec.ts` — passes with guard, fails without (confirmed)
